### Calling the Great Physician
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/calling-the-great-physician-encouragement-for-today-oct-30-2009-11610513.html
Passage: Mark 2:17
Points:
- People often stubbornly attempt to carry burdens alone instead of asking God for help.
- Jesus came to provide profound spiritual healing from sin rather than mere physical relief.
- Christ reached out to outcasts because those who are sick need a physician.
- Bringing our struggles to God grants an inner peace that guards the heart.
- Believers should seek the Great Physician daily rather than as an exhausted last resort.

### Power Point - October 17, 2005
Author: PowerPoint Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/power-point-october-17-2005-1356281.html
Passage: Mark 2:16-17
Points:
- Religious critics condemned Jesus for dining in the company of tax collectors and sinners.
- Jesus viewed outcasts not with disdain, but as hurting patients requiring spiritual healing.
- Finding a spiritual cure begins with humbly admitting our sickness with sin.
- Believers must not hide away, but step out in love to lead hurting people to the Savior.
